description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting – Data and Analytics – Databricks Architect – Senior Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The Senior Delivery Manager & Data Architect is a senior client-facing leader accountable for the end-to-end delivery and architectural integrity of complex data, analytics, cloud, and AI transformation programmes. The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the single point of accountability for delivery outcomes while defining target-state data architectures, engineering standards, governance controls, and transformation roadmaps. The role requires the ability to move confidently between executive discussions, programme governance, solution design, and technical assurance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream data and analytics programmes from discovery and mobilisation through implementation, transition, and benefits realisation.
* Establish integrated plans, governance forums, delivery cadence, quality gates, dependency management, and executive reporting.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, capacity, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, and change control; intervene early when delivery deviates from commitments.
* Drive Agile, Scrum, scaled Agile, or hybrid delivery practices appropriate to the client and programme context.
* Lead platform migrations, modernisation initiatives, releases, cutovers, hypercare, and transition to operations with clear readiness and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain delivery transparency using measurable outcomes, milestone health, financial performance, engineering metrics, and value-realisation indicators.
* Define enterprise data strategy, target-state architecture, reference architectures, transition states, and prioritised transformation roadmaps aligned to business and AI objectives.
* Architect modern cloud-native data platforms, including data lakes, lakehouses, warehouses, streaming solutions, data products, semantic layers, APIs, and analytical consumption patterns.
* Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling using dimensional, relational, Data Vault, graph, ontology, and domain-oriented approaches as appropriate.
* Define integration and ingestion patterns for batch, near-real-time, event-driven, CDC, API, and file-based workloads.
* Evaluate platforms, products, and design alternatives; produce architecture decisions, solution blueprints, non-functional requirements, and implementation guardrails.
* Provide architecture assurance across the delivery lifecycle through design reviews, proofs of concept, engineering standards, performance reviews, and technical risk management.
* Ensure solutions meet requirements for scalability, resilience, availability, observability, interoperability, security, privacy, maintainability, and cost optimisation.
* Establish governance principles covering data ownership, stewardship, classification, lineage, metadata, master and reference data, retention, and policy enforcement.
* Embed data quality controls, reconciliation, auditability, privacy-by-design, role-based access, encryption, and regulatory compliance into solution architecture and delivery.
* Partner with cyber security, risk, legal, compliance, and operations teams to ensure controls are demonstrable and audit-ready.
* Build trusted relationships with C-suite sponsors, business leaders, product owners, technology executives, and delivery partners.
* Translate complex business needs into clear solution options, investment cases, roadmaps, and outcome-based delivery plans.
* Facilitate executive workshops, architecture forums, steering committees, and difficult decision-making conversations.
* Own or support proposals, solution shaping, estimates, statements of work, delivery models, contract assumptions, and commercial negotiations.
* Manage programme financials, forecasting, burn, margin, resourcing, vendors, and third-party commitments.
* Identify opportunities for account growth, reusable assets, accelerators, and follow-on transformation initiatives.
* Lead multidisciplinary teams of architects, data engineers, platform engineers, analysts, data scientists, DevOps specialists, quality engineers, and project managers.
* Set clear accountabilities, create a high-performance culture, mentor senior practitioners, and develop succession and capability plans.
* Promote engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, reusable patterns, continuous improvement, and responsible use of data and AI.
* Contribute to hiring, workforce planning, communities of practice, thought leadership, and organisational capability development.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
* Typically 15+ years of technology experience, including substantial experience delivering enterprise data programmes and operating in a lead data or solution architecture capacity.
* Demonstrable ownership of large, complex, multi-team programmes with responsibility for delivery governance, senior stakeholders, budgets, quality, and commercial outcomes.
* Strong experience designing and delivering cloud data platforms on Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud; deep expertise in at least one ecosystem is essential.
* Proven experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, cloud object storage, and modern BI tools.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL and strong working understanding of Python or PySpark, data integration, distributed processing, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and observability.
* Solid command of data modelling, metadata management, data quality, master data management, governance, privacy, security, and lifecycle management.
* Experience architecting AI-ready data foundations and integrating machine learning, generative AI, vector, semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph capabilities is desirable.
* Excellent executive communication, consulting, negotiation, facilitation, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Cloud architecture or data engineering certification in Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
* Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, or Snowflake certification.
* TOGAF, DAMA/CDMP, or an equivalent data or enterprise architecture credential.
* PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum, or an equivalent programme or Agile delivery certification.
* ITIL certification is advantageous for roles with service transition or operational accountability.
* Delivery against agreed outcomes, milestones, budget, quality standards, and contractual commitments.
* Architecture compliance, reduction in technical debt, and adoption of reusable standards and patterns.
* Platform reliability, performance, security, data quality, observability, and unit-cost improvement.
* Stakeholder confidence, client satisfaction, benefits realisation, and successful adoption of delivered capabilities.
* Team engagement, capability growth, predictable staffing, and development of future technical and delivery leaders.
* Commercial performance, pipeline contribution, and expansion of trusted client relationships.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: CRO Specialist
description:
**About the role**

Axeno’s conversion rate optimization (CRO) and experimentation practice helps enterprise clients grow website conversion. We turn analytics evidence into prioritised experiments and personalized experiences, and prove the business impact.

As Scrum Master & CRO Specialist you are the analytical and delivery lead of a CRO squad. You own journey analysis, drop-off diagnosis, hypotheses, experiment design and KPI interpretation, and you run the sprint cadence that keeps every cycle on time, evidence-backed and decision-ready. You will also strengthen the practice by evolving the playbooks, templates and ways of working we reuse across clients.

**What you will do**

**CRO and insights**

•   
**Journey and funnel analysis.**
Analyse the end-to-end website journey in Adobe Analytics. Build funnels, fallout and cohort views by source, device and new vs returning traffic.

•   
**Drop-off diagnosis.**
Combine quantitative funnels with session replay, heatmaps, zoning and journey analysis from Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare to explain friction.

•   
**Hypotheses.**
Produce focused insight briefs with ranked hypotheses, each with evidence, affected audience and a primary KPI.

•   
**Experiment design.**
Specify tests (A/B, experience targeting, personalization rules) with primary KPI, eligible audience, minimum detectable effect, allocation, control and decision window. Report absolute and relative effect with uncertainty and guardrails, and call “continue learning” when the evidence says so.

•   
**Measurement integrity.**
Define and maintain a measurement contract: journey events, experiment IDs, and reconciliation across SDK, analytics and server/CRM counts. Link website conversions to downstream lead quality.

•   
**Reporting.**
Maintain KPI dashboards covering conversion, lead quality and guardrails (Core Web Vitals, form reliability, personalization delivery, data integrity).

•   
**Activation partnership.**
Work with personalization and engineering specialists on Adobe Target and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization campaigns: targeting logic, preview and tracking QA, rollout and rollback.

**Scrum and delivery**

•   
Run a fortnightly delivery cycle: evidence mining, test agreement, build and verify, release and review. Facilitate planning, daily check-ins, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives.

•   
Own the prioritised backlog and a written decision log (launch, continue, revise, stop, escalate). Prioritise by opportunity, effort and traffic using a framework such as ICE or PIE.

•   
Track dependencies on client platform, data and BAU teams (access, consent, SDK, approved content). Raise blockers and risks early, and keep acceptance evidence for every deliverable.

•   
Be the day-to-day contact for client marketing and digital stakeholders. Present readouts in plain business language, without overclaiming uplift.

**Practice contribution**

•   
Maintain and improve reusable assets: hypothesis and experiment brief templates, QA checklists, KPI frameworks, dashboards and a CRO operating playbook.

•   
Support pre-sales and proposals with CRO approach, scoping and case studies. Coach junior analysts and personalization specialists across the team.

**﻿
Must-have requirements**

**Non-negotiable**

*Hands-on CRO delivery for comparable customers (large consumer or lead-generation websites, ideally automotive, BFSI or other high-consideration journeys), with proven, quantified impact you can walk us through.*

•   
6–7 years in web analytics, CRO or digital optimization, with at least 3 years running an experimentation programme end to end.

•   
Case studies we can verify: the problem, hypothesis, test design, result (with confidence or uncertainty) and business impact, e.g. lift in lead or conversion rate without loss in lead quality.

•   
Strong Adobe Analytics skills: Analysis Workspace, segments, calculated metrics, fallout and flow, eVars/props/events.

•   
Hands-on experience with Adobe Target (activities, audiences, A/B and experience targeting, QA; A4T is a plus).

•   
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare for session replay, heatmaps, zone-based and journey analysis.

•   
Working knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (Interaction Studio) and how Data Cloud segments feed website personalization.

•   
Solid grasp of experiment statistics: sample size and MDE, significance and confidence intervals, sample ratio mismatch, novelty effects, overlapping tests.

•   
Scrum fundamentals: you can run ceremonies, manage a backlog and unblock a team. CSM or PSM certification preferred.

•   
Clear written and verbal communication, able to turn data into a recommendation for non-technical stakeholders.

**Good to have**

•   
Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target or Salesforce certifications.

•   
Experience with consent-aware measurement and privacy-safe personalization (including India DPDP requirements).

•   
Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, tag management (Adobe Launch, GTM) and basic SQL or Python for ad-hoc analysis.

•   
Experience linking web leads to CRM or dealer outcomes (Salesforce, Data Cloud).

•   
Agency or consulting background with client-facing experience.

 Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
   

  

 Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber \& Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India \- one in Noida focused on Cyber \& Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair \& Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 As a Senior Technical Lead, you will lead end\-to\-end development of product features and act as a technical bridge between Architects, Product Management, and the engineering team. You will contribute hands\-on to building and validating secure, high\-quality solutions (with strong unit test coverage), troubleshoot and resolve customer escalations, and drive innovation through PoCs and continuous technical improvements across our Java/cloud\-native stack (e.g., Spring Boot, Kubernetes, microservices, and deployments).
   

  

**Job Requirement And Responsibilities**
* Senior Technical lead will be responsible for leading autonomously the product feature developments, maintaining or developing/architecting software applications and systems.
* He should be technically adequate to work as an individual contributor, and work as a bridge between Architects and Product Management and the team.
* You need to follow development processes and security processes, and will ensure the technical quality of the solution with UTs coverage and handle/identify security vulnerabilities.
* You will work on Customers escalated issues.
* You will get exposure to working on cutting\-edge technologies and innovation events.
* Drive innovation by proposing, prototyping, and evaluating new technical solutions (PoCs), and contribute to continuous improvements in performance, scalability, and developer productivity.
* Contribute innovative ideas for technical improvements and processes.
* Technologies should not be any constraints for the right person, we work on Java, React, Kotlin, Kubernetes, and maintain/own the deployments and charts definitions for our applications.


**Job Knowledge, Skill And Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science/computer engineering/Electronics and Communication 10\+ years of application development on Java and cloud tech stack.
* Strong experience in implementing Rest API based applications using Java tech stack with strong knowledge of Spring, Spring Boot frameworks.
* Core knowledge in Data Structures, OOPS, Solid design principles, and common Design Patterns is must.
* Working exposure to any cloud stack (GCP, AWS) is must.
* Leveraging AI in routine work or personal POCs will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to Cloud and Kubernetes\-based applications will be an important factor.
* The ideal candidate should be technology\-agnostic, adaptable, and comfortable learning and working across different languages, frameworks, and platforms as required.
* Hands\-on experience with a modern cloud\-friendly programming language such as Python or Node.js. will be an added advantage.
* Experience in Unit Testing and any automation (BDD) framework will be nice to have.
* Good exposure to any relational database MSSQL or MySql.
* Exposure in Micro Services architecture and Docker based application will be an added advantage.
* Exposure to frontend technologies such as React or Angular will be an added advantage.


**What do we offer?**
 At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!
   

  

 At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Job Description
 



**About the Role** 




 This role is a client\-facing leadership position responsible for managing end\-to\-end project delivery while also acting as a Scrum Master for multiple Agile teams. The individual will be accountable for ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to customer expectations.
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Drive end\-to\-end project management activities ensuring successful delivery within scope, timeline, and budget
* **Owning** 
 the delivery end to end by exhibiting problem\-solving skills
* Lead Agile ceremonies and act as Scrum Master for
 **multiple** 
 cross\-functional teams at the same time
* Owning the comprehensive Change management process at the customer side
* At the customer side, preparing \& Managing project plans, sprint backlogs, and workflows
* Proactively suggesting improvements in the process and coming up with hard ($) savings/ soft savings (process improvements)
* Responding quickly to the customer ask
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to define priorities and align project goals
* Lead and mentor Project Management and Scrum teams
* Provide regular project status updates, identify risks, and drive mitigation plans
* Build strong client relationships through effective communication and stakeholder management



**Required Skills:** 



* Project Management experience along with hands\-on Scrum Master experience
* Strong expertise in JIRA and Monday.com (preferably at the admin level too)
* Experience in managing large teams (including 3
 *rd* 
 party vendors) and leading PM/SM functions
* Scrum certified (CSM/PSM)
* Must have handled US/UK customers
* Confident personality with exceptional verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent stakeholder management and client\-facing communication skills
* Experience working directly with Product Owners and Business Analysts
* Ability to work with US stakeholders in overlapping time zones

title: Jira Master
description:
**About Parksmart:** 




 Parksmart Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a smart parking and mobility technology company providing technology\-driven parking and access management solutions across residential societies, commercial properties, hotels, hospitals, and other establishments.
 



**Job Overview:** 


 We are looking for a Jira Master who will be responsible for managing Jira, optimizing workflows, tracking projects and tasks, and ensuring effective adoption of Jira across different teams. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Jira administration, Agile processes, workflow management, dashboards, and automation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Manage and administer Jira projects, users, roles, and permissions.
 



 • Create and maintain workflows, issue types, custom fields, screens, and notifications.
 



 • Track project progress, tasks, bugs, priorities, and deadlines.
 



 • Create dashboards, reports, filters, and project metrics for management.
 



 • Configure Jira automation to streamline repetitive tasks and processes.
 



 • Work closely with teams to understand requirements and configure Jira accordingly.
 



 • Monitor Jira usage and ensure teams follow defined processes.
 



 • Troubleshoot Jira\-related issues and provide support to users.
 



 • Coordinate with Product, Technology, Operations, and other teams for effective project tracking. • Maintain Jira documentation and continuously improve workflows and processes.
 



 • Support Agile/Scrum ceremonies and ensure proper task tracking in Jira.
 



 • Manage or coordinate Jira integrations with tools such as Confluence, Slack, Git, etc. 
 



  





**Requirements •** 




 2–5 years of experience in Jira administration, Jira management, or a similar role.
 



 • Strong hands\-on knowledge of Jira Software.
 



 • Experience with Jira workflows, dashboards, automation, permissions, and reporting.
 



 • Good understanding of Agile, Scrum, and Kanban methodologies.
 



 • Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
 



 • Good communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
